description: Find National Park Service, Forest Service and California State Parks campgrounds by name, id, park or national forest (e.g. "Yosemite", "Shasta-Trinity"), or state ("CO", "Colorado"), with whether each is open today and its booking link. Returns ids for campgrounds_get_status. NPS campgrounds follow the park's published schedule; Forest Service ones show the listed status (refreshed every 6 hours). California State Parks camping areas are from its official GIS catalog, which supplies no opening status. "not listed" means unknown, not closed. California State Parks attribution is required; commercial GIS use requires permission (https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=29682).

query.description: Name, id, park, forest or state, case-insensitive

name: campgrounds_search
title: Search campgrounds
